snippet.title: Taz: Wanted (PS2/Xbox/GC/PC) (2002) Video Game UK Developers Trailer
snippet.description:
UK Developers Trailer for the Taz: Wanted videogame.
This trailer was not created by Infogrames/Atari, the publishers of the game. Instead, it was created by Blitz Games, the developers of the game.

Platforms in which this game was released: PlayStation 2, Xbox, Nintendo GameCube, Windows
